cohort: Pregnant women between 20 and 34 weeks of gestation whose fetuses underwent IUT by cordocentesis between January 1991 and June 2021
finding: The most common complications of IUT for Rh alloimmunization were post-transfusion cord bleeding, fetal bradycardia, premature rupture of membranes, and emergency cesarean section, with bradycardia being the complication most associated with fetal and neonatal death.
mod_finding: We had two cases of emergency cesarean section (mean of 0.51% per IUT).
